notes.title: Gunbrella demo is live!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello you amazing people! [/h2]

For those who are not aware we are working on a new game, Gunbrella! 

Sometimes you need an umbrella, sometimes you need a gun. Now you can have both at the same time(don't ask why we are yet to figuring that out). From the makers of Gato Roboto, Doinksofts Gunbrella will take you on a noir-punk adventure filled with action! 

[h3]Try it now, and wishlist it right after! [/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1580180/Gunbrella/
